title: lobelia macrophylla
intro: Lobelia macrophylla, commonly known as "Indian tobacco," is a plant species belonging to the family Campanulaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and coughs. The health benefits of Lobelia macrophylla include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic actions, which may help to reduce muscle cramps and spasms. The plant contains bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
